text:
## Findings

| # | Severity | File / lines | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | High | `robots.txt:5-6`, `geo.config.json:1` | GEO policy says AI search crawlers are allowed, but `GPTBot` is blocked site-wide. The policy is also not reflected for other major AI crawlers. | Decide the intended policy, then align `robots.txt`. Allow search crawlers such as `OAI-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, and `ClaudeBot` if desired; block training-only crawlers separately. |
| 2 | High | `geo.config.json:1`, `robots.txt:5-6` | `trainingCrawlers: "block"` is not actually enforced except for GPTBot. A config file alone is not a broadly recognized crawler-control mechanism. | Express the policy in production `robots.txt` using the relevant crawler user agents, and verify the deployment serves this file. |
| 3 | High | `index.html:3-10`, `classes.html:3-10`, `breads.html:3-10` | No JSON-LD structured data exists. Search engines and AI systems receive no explicit `Bakery`/`LocalBusiness`, `Product`, `Course`, or `Offer` entities. | Add valid JSON-LD: `Bakery`/`LocalBusiness` on the homepage, bread/product data on `breads.html`, and `Course`/`Event`/`Offer` data for classes. Only publish factual fields. |
| 4 | Medium | `index.html:13-17` | The homepage lacks core local-business facts: address, opening hours, phone, service area, ordering URL, and collection details. This limits local SEO and answerability in AI search. | Add a clearly labeled contact/location section with NAP data, hours, collection instructions, and a direct ordering link. |
| 5 | Medium | `classes.html:13-15` | The classes page says “Book early” but has no booking link, dates, duration, price, location, capacity, or availability. It is not useful for transactional or AI-generated answers. | Add complete class details and a crawlable booking/ enquiry CTA. Add matching structured data. |
| 6 | Medium | `breads.html:13-16` | “Over twenty loaves” is not an indexable product/catalogue structure; the named breads have no descriptions, ingredients, sizes, prices, availability, or collection information. | Create individual product entries or a structured catalogue with stable names, descriptions, pricing, availability, and relevant `Product`/`Offer` markup. |
| 7 | High | `breads.html:16` | `data-nosnippet` hides the allergen statement from search snippets and potentially AI extraction. This suppresses important user-safety information. | Remove `data-nosnippet`; provide a complete, accurate allergen policy and item-level allergen information. |
| 8 | Medium | `index.html:3-10`, `classes.html:3-10`, `breads.html:3-10` | Open Graph and Twitter/X metadata are absent, reducing link-preview quality and shareability. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:type`, `og:image`, and equivalent Twitter/X metadata on indexable pages. |
| 9 | Medium | `members/index.html:8-9`, `robots.txt:3` | The members page is both `noindex` and disallowed in `robots.txt`. Crawlers blocked by robots cannot reliably read the `noindex` directive; this is also unsuitable as access control. | If private, protect it with authentication or return an appropriate status. If it only needs exclusion from indexing, remove the robots disallow and retain `noindex`. |
| 10 | Low | `index.html:12-17`, `classes.html:12-15`, `breads.html:12-16` | Content is very thin for a local bakery: little evidence of expertise, trust, service details, FAQs, or authoritative answers that AI systems can cite. | Add useful first-party content: sourcing, baking process, collection expectations, FAQs, class policy, delivery/ordering details, and testimonials or reviews where legitimate. |

## Already handled correctly

Canonical URLs are present on all pages, the main pages have unique titles/descriptions and one clear `<h1>`, `members/` is excluded from the sitemap, and `robots.txt` advertises the sitemap.
